functions.name: bridge_emit_signal_v1
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION atlas.bridge_emit_signal_v1()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'atlas'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_bridge_hash TEXT;
    v_source_connector_id UUID;
    v_raw_record_id UUID;
    v_statute_id UUID;
    v_rule_id TEXT;
    v_generation_method TEXT;
    v_record_origin TEXT;
    v_verification_status TEXT;
    v_confidence NUMERIC(5,4);
    v_severity TEXT;
BEGIN
    -- Build deterministic bridge hash from signal lineage
    v_bridge_hash := md5(
        COALESCE(NEW.signal_id::TEXT, '') || '|' ||
        COALESCE(NEW.detected_at::TEXT, '') || '|' ||
        COALESCE(NEW.jurisdiction_raw_value, '') || '|' ||
        COALESCE(NEW.severity, '') || '|' ||
        COALESCE(NEW.signal_type, '')
    );

    -- Skip if already emitted (idempotency check via audit table)
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM atlas.bridge_operational_audit
        WHERE bridge_hash = v_bridge_hash
    ) THEN
        RETURN NEW;
    END IF;

    -- Resolve deterministic UUIDs
    v_source_connector_id := COALESCE(
        NEW.source_connector_id,
        uuid_generate_v5('c4d3870c-ed9e-581d-a09f-1a49d907f95e'::uuid,
            COALESCE(NEW.source_table, 'atlas') || ':' || COALESCE(NEW.source_record_id, NEW.signal_id::TEXT))
    );

    v_raw_record_id := COALESCE(
        NEW.raw_record_id,
        uuid_generate_v5('9b244453-7c1b-5ec9-ba16-19a1241feb91'::uuid,
            COALESCE(NEW.source_record_id, NEW.signal_id::TEXT))
    );

    v_statute_id := COALESCE(
        NEW.statute_id,
        uuid_generate_v5('049037fa-6682-5046-9020-39bc55ff37e9'::uuid,
            COALESCE(NEW.signal_type, 'unknown'))
    );

    v_rule_id := COALESCE(NEW.rule_id, NEW.signal_type || '_v1');
    v_generation_method := COALESCE(NEW.generation_method, 'deterministic_rule');
    v_record_origin := COALESCE(NEW.record_origin, 'streaming_investigation');
    v_verification_status := COALESCE(NEW.verification_status, 'verified');
    v_confidence := COALESCE(NEW.confidence_score, NEW.severity_score, 0.5);
    v_severity := COALESCE(NEW.severity,
        CASE
            WHEN v_confidence >= 0.9 THEN 'critical'
            WHEN v_confidence >= 0.8 THEN 'high'
            WHEN v_confidence >= 0.7 THEN 'medium'
            WHEN v_confidence >= 0.5 THEN 'low'
            ELSE 'info'
        END
    );

    -- Emit to canonical bridge table (idempotent on atlas_signal_id)
    INSERT INTO public.atlas_lighthouse_signal_bridge_v1 (
        atlas_signal_id,
        signal_type,
        source_system,
        bridge_version,
        source_connector_id,
        raw_record_id,
        statute_id,
        entity_ids,
        jurisdiction_raw_value,
        jurisdiction_id,
        source_url,
        detected_at,
        confidence_score,
        severity,
        signal_status,
        rule_id,
        rule_version,
        generation_method,
        record_origin,
        verification_status,
        evidence_payload,
        provenance_metadata,
        atlas_metadata_json,
        atlas_signal_dedup_key,
        source_view,
        bridge_metadata
    ) VALUES (
        NEW.signal_id,
        NEW.signal_type,
        'atlas',
        'atlas_lighthouse_bridge_v1',
        v_source_connector_id,
        v_raw_record_id,
        v_statute_id,
        COALESCE(NEW.entity_ids, ARRAY[]::TEXT[]),
        NEW.jurisdiction_raw_value,
        NEW.jurisdiction_id::TEXT,
        COALESCE(NEW.source_url, ''),
        COALESCE(NEW.detected_at, NOW()),
        v_confidence,
        v_severity,
        COALESCE(NEW.signal_status, 'active'),
        v_rule_id,
        COALESCE(NEW.rule_version, 'v1'),
        v_generation_method,
        v_record_origin,
        v_verification_status,
        COALESCE(NEW.evidence_payload, '{}'::jsonb),
        COALESCE(NEW.provenance_metadata, '{}'::jsonb),
        COALESCE(NEW.metadata_json, '{}'::jsonb),
        COALESCE(NEW.signal_dedup_key, 'atlas|' || NEW.signal_id::TEXT),
        'public.v_civic_map_signals_production',
        jsonb_build_object(
            'hook', 'bridge_emit_signal_v1',
            'bridge_id', 'atlas-to-lighthouse',
            'bridge_hash', v_bridge_hash,
            'source_table', 'atlas.civic_map_signals',
            'emitted_at', NOW()
        )
    )
    ON CONFLICT (atlas_signal_id) DO NOTHING;

    -- Log to operational audit (use DO NOTHING to avoid partial index issue)
    INSERT INTO atlas.bridge_operational_audit (
        signal_id, signal_type, bridge_hash, emitted_at,
        jurisdiction, confidence_score, severity, processing_status, metadata
    ) VALUES (
        NEW.signal_id, NEW.signal_type, v_bridge_hash, NOW(),
        NEW.jurisdiction_raw_value, v_confidence, v_severity, 'emitted',
        jsonb_build_object('source_table', NEW.source_table, 'rule_id', v_rule_id)
    )
    ON CONFLICT (bridge_hash) DO NOTHING;

    RETURN NEW;

EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
    -- Log failure without ON CONFLICT to avoid constraint issues
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO atlas.bridge_operational_audit (
            signal_id, signal_type, bridge_hash, emitted_at, processing_status, failure_reason
        ) VALUES (
            NEW.signal_id, NEW.signal_type, v_bridge_hash, NOW(), 'failed', SQLERRM
        );
    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
        -- Silently ignore audit failure — do not block the original INSERT
        NULL;
    END;
    RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

functions.name: bridge_escalate_convergence
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION atlas.bridge_escalate_convergence(p_convergence_event_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'atlas'
AS $function$
        DECLARE
            v_event RECORD;
            v_result JSONB;
            v_jurisdiction TEXT;
        BEGIN
            -- Look up the convergence event
            SELECT * INTO v_event FROM atlas.convergence_events WHERE id = p_convergence_event_id;
            
            IF v_event IS NULL THEN
                RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'Convergence event not found: ' || p_convergence_event_id);
            END IF;

            -- Already linked to Prism?
            IF v_event.prism_case_id IS NOT NULL THEN
                RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'Already linked to Prism case: ' || v_event.prism_case_id);
            END IF;

            -- Determine jurisdiction
            v_jurisdiction := COALESCE(v_event.affected_jurisdictions[1], 'United States');

            -- Push to Prism
            v_result := atlas.bridge_push_to_prism(
                p_title := 'Convergent Failure: ' || v_event.event_name,
                p_description := 'Atlas convergence engine detected a multi-signal convergent failure event. Convergence score: ' || v_event.convergence_score || ', Confidence: ' || v_event.confidence || '. Affected entities: ' || array_to_string(v_event.affected_entities, ', ') || '. Corruption indicator: ' || v_event.is_corruption_indicator,
                p_jurisdiction := v_jurisdiction,
                p_finding_summary := 'Convergent failure detected: ' || v_event.event_name || '. ' || array_length(v_event.signal_ids, 1) || ' signals converged with score ' || v_event.convergence_score,
                p_finding_confidence := CASE 
                    WHEN v_event.confidence >= 0.8 THEN 'high'
                    WHEN v_event.confidence >= 0.5 THEN 'medium'
                    ELSE 'low'
                END,
                p_finding_metadata := jsonb_build_object(
                    'convergence_event_id', v_event.id,
                    'convergence_score', v_event.convergence_score,
                    'confidence', v_event.confidence,
                    'signal_ids', v_event.signal_ids,
                    'is_corruption_indicator', v_event.is_corruption_indicator,
                    'is_reparative_opportunity', v_event.is_reparative_opportunity,
                    'affected_entities', v_event.affected_entities,
                    'affected_jurisdictions', v_event.affected_jurisdictions
                ),
                p_recommendation_action := CASE 
                    WHEN v_event.is_corruption_indicator THEN 'ESCALATE_CORRUPTION'
                    WHEN v_event.is_reparative_opportunity THEN 'ASSESS_REPARATIVE'
                    ELSE 'INVESTIGATE_CONVERGENCE'
                END,
                p_recommendation_summary := CASE 
                    WHEN v_event.is_corruption_indicator THEN 'URGENT: Corruption indicator detected. Escalate to oversight body for immediate review.'
                    WHEN v_event.is_reparative_opportunity THEN 'Reparative opportunity identified. Assess for community benefit action.'
                    ELSE 'Multi-signal convergence detected. Investigate underlying patterns.'
                END,
                p_source_table := 'convergence_events',
                p_source_record_id := v_event.id::text
            );

            -- Update the convergence event with the Prism case ID
            IF (v_result->>'success')::boolean = true THEN
                UPDATE atlas.convergence_events SET 
                    prism_case_id = (v_result->>'case_id')::uuid,
                    status = 'escalated'
                WHERE id = p_convergence_event_id;
            END IF;

            RETURN v_result;
        END;
        $function$

functions.name: bridge_escalate_detection_rule
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION atlas.bridge_escalate_detection_rule(p_rule_id character varying, p_matched_record_ids text[] DEFAULT NULL::text[], p_additional_context jsonb DEFAULT NULL::jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'atlas'
AS $function$
        DECLARE
            v_rule RECORD;
            v_jurisdiction TEXT;
            v_result JSONB;
        BEGIN
            -- Look up the detection rule
            SELECT * INTO v_rule FROM atlas.detection_rules WHERE rule_id = p_rule_id AND enabled = true;
            
            IF v_rule IS NULL THEN
                RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'Detection rule not found or disabled: ' || p_rule_id);
            END IF;

            -- Determine jurisdiction from domain
            SELECT COALESCE(
                (SELECT geography_name FROM atlas.geography_registry WHERE geography_key = 'US' LIMIT 1),
                'United States'
            ) INTO v_jurisdiction;

            -- Push to Prism
            v_result := atlas.bridge_push_to_prism(
                p_title := 'Detection Alert: ' || v_rule.rule_name,
                p_description := 'Atlas detection rule ' || v_rule.rule_id || ' (' || v_rule.rule_name || ') fired on table ' || v_rule.target_table || '. Domain: ' || COALESCE(v_rule.domain_code, 'UNKNOWN') || '. Signal type: ' || v_rule.signal_type,
                p_jurisdiction := v_jurisdiction,
                p_finding_summary := 'Automated detection: ' || v_rule.rule_name || ' triggered. Threshold parameters: ' || v_rule.threshold_parameters::text,
                p_finding_confidence := CASE 
                    WHEN v_rule.precedence_weight >= 8 THEN 'high'
                    WHEN v_rule.precedence_weight >= 5 THEN 'medium'
                    ELSE 'low'
                END,
                p_finding_metadata := jsonb_build_object(
                    'rule_id', v_rule.rule_id,
                    'domain_code', v_rule.domain_code,
                    'signal_type', v_rule.signal_type,
                    'target_table', v_rule.target_table,
                    'matched_record_ids', COALESCE(p_matched_record_ids, ARRAY[]::text[]),
                    'additional_context', COALESCE(p_additional_context, '{}'::jsonb)
                ),
                p_recommendation_action := 'INVESTIGATE_' || COALESCE(v_rule.domain_code, 'UNKNOWN'),
                p_recommendation_summary := 'Investigate detection alert from rule ' || v_rule.rule_id || ' on domain ' || COALESCE(v_rule.domain_code, 'UNKNOWN') || '. Review matched records and assess for escalation.',
                p_source_table := 'detection_rules',
                p_source_record_id := v_rule.rule_id
            );

            RETURN v_result;
        END;
        $function$
functions.identity_arguments: p_rule_id character varying, p_matched_record_ids text[], p_additional_context jsonb

functions.name: bridge_push_action_to_lighthouse
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION atlas.bridge_push_action_to_lighthouse()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'atlas'
AS $function$
BEGIN
    -- Only push actionable items (not system/maintenance actions)
    IF NEW.action_type IN ('corruption_investigation', 'displacement_alert', 'facility_closure_risk',
                           'water_crisis_alert', 'benefit_access_gap', 'legal_aid_escalation',
                           'regulatory_capture_detected', 'judicial_anomaly_flagged') THEN

        INSERT INTO lighthouse_cases (
            atlas_action_id,
            case_type,
            case_title,
            case_description,
            severity_score,
            priority_score,
            geography_key,
            jurisdiction,
            source_domain,
            source_reference_id,
            source_reference_table,
            atlas_created_at
        )
        SELECT
            NEW.action_id,
            NEW.action_type,
            COALESCE(NEW.action_details->>'title', NEW.action_type),
            COALESCE(NEW.action_details->>'description', 'Auto-generated from Atlas detection'),
            COALESCE((NEW.priority_score::DECIMAL / 1000), 0.50),
            NEW.priority_score,
            NEW.action_details->>'geography_key',
            NEW.action_details->>'jurisdiction',
            NEW.source_domain,
            NEW.source_reference_id,
            NEW.source_reference_table,
            NEW.created_at
        ON CONFLICT (atlas_action_id) DO UPDATE SET
            severity_score = EXCLUDED.severity_score,
            priority_score = EXCLUDED.priority_score,
            case_description = EXCLUDED.case_description,
            last_activity_at = NOW();
    END IF;

    RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

functions.name: bridge_push_resources_to_lighthouse
functions.comment: Pushes HUMS resources (food banks, benefits offices, legal aid) into Lighthouse civic map as green resource pins. Call after HUMS ingestion.
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION atlas.bridge_push_resources_to_lighthouse()
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'atlas'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_count INT := 0;
BEGIN
    -- Food banks as resource pins
    INSERT INTO lighthouse_map_pins (
        geography_key, pin_type, pin_subtype, title, description,
        latitude, longitude, color_hex, atlas_updated_at, expires_at
    )
    SELECT
        COALESCE(lr.geography_key, 'us-wa-king-county'),
        'resource',
        'food_bank',
        fb.pantry_name,
        'Serves: ' || COALESCE(fb.languages, 'English') ||
        CASE WHEN fb.serves_children THEN ', Children' ELSE '' END ||
        CASE WHEN fb.serves_seniors THEN ', Seniors' ELSE '' END ||
        CASE WHEN fb.serves_homeless THEN ', Homeless' ELSE '' END ||
        '. Hours: ' || COALESCE(fb.hours, 'Call for hours'),
        fb.latitude,
        fb.longitude,
        '#10b981',
        fb.updated_at,
        NOW() + INTERVAL '7 days'
    FROM food_banks fb
    LEFT JOIN location_registry lr ON fb.pantry_name = lr.address_raw  -- simplified join
    WHERE fb.latitude IS NOT NULL AND fb.longitude IS NOT NULL
    ON CONFLICT (geography_key, pin_type, entity_id, signal_id) DO UPDATE SET
        title = EXCLUDED.title,
        description = EXCLUDED.description,
        atlas_updated_at = EXCLUDED.atlas_updated_at,
        expires_at = EXCLUDED.expires_at;

    GET DIAGNOSTICS v_count = ROW_COUNT;

    -- Benefits offices as resource pins
    INSERT INTO lighthouse_map_pins (
        geography_key, pin_type, pin_subtype, title, description,
        latitude, longitude, color_hex, atlas_updated_at, expires_at
    )
    SELECT
        COALESCE(lr.geography_key, 'us-wa'),
        'resource',
        'benefits_office',
        bo.office_name,
        'Program: ' || bo.program_type ||
        '. Walk-in: ' || COALESCE(bo.walk_in::TEXT, 'Unknown') ||
        '. Appointment: ' || COALESCE(bo.appointment_required::TEXT, 'Unknown') ||
        '. Phone: ' || COALESCE(bo.phone, 'N/A'),
        bo.latitude,
        bo.longitude,
        '#3b82f6',
        bo.updated_at,
        NOW() + INTERVAL '7 days'
    FROM benefits_offices bo
    LEFT JOIN location_registry lr ON bo.office_name = lr.address_raw
    WHERE bo.latitude IS NOT NULL AND bo.longitude IS NOT NULL
    ON CONFLICT (geography_key, pin_type, entity_id, signal_id) DO UPDATE SET
        title = EXCLUDED.title,
        description = EXCLUDED.description,
        atlas_updated_at = EXCLUDED.atlas_updated_at;

    -- Legal aid as resource pins
    INSERT INTO lighthouse_map_pins (
        geography_key, pin_type, pin_subtype, title, description,
        latitude, longitude, color_hex, atlas_updated_at, expires_at
    )
    SELECT
        COALESCE(lr.geography_key, 'us-wa'),
        'resource',
        'legal_aid',
        lap.provider_name,
        'Service: ' || lap.service_type ||
        '. Same-day: ' || COALESCE(lap.same_day_intake::TEXT, 'Unknown') ||
        '. FPL threshold: ' || COALESCE(lap.income_threshold_fpl::TEXT, 'Unknown') ||
        '. Phone: ' || COALESCE(lap.phone, 'N/A'),
        NULL,  -- legal aid may not have lat/lon yet
        NULL,
        '#8b5cf6',
        lap.updated_at,
        NOW() + INTERVAL '7 days'
    FROM legal_aid_providers lap
    LEFT JOIN location_registry lr ON lap.provider_name = lr.address_raw
    ON CONFLICT (geography_key, pin_type, entity_id, signal_id) DO UPDATE SET
        title = EXCLUDED.title,
        description = EXCLUDED.description,
        atlas_updated_at = EXCLUDED.atlas_updated_at;

    RETURN v_count;
END;
$function$

functions.name: bridge_push_signal_to_lighthouse
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION atlas.bridge_push_signal_to_lighthouse(p_queue_id bigint)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'atlas'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_queue RECORD;
    v_payload JSONB;
    v_case_id UUID;
    v_snapshot_id UUID;
    v_pipeline_run_id UUID;
    v_claim_id UUID;
    v_finding_id UUID;
    v_severity_enum TEXT;
    v_result JSONB;
    v_meta JSONB;
    v_city TEXT;
    v_office_count TEXT;
    v_signal_type TEXT;
    v_confidence NUMERIC;
BEGIN
    SELECT * INTO v_queue
    FROM atlas.lighthouse_bridge_queue
    WHERE queue_id = p_queue_id
      AND status IN ('pending','retrying')
      AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at <= NOW())
    FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED;

    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object(
            'success', FALSE,
            'error', 'Queue item not found or not ready',
            'queue_id', p_queue_id
        );
    END IF;

    v_payload := v_queue.payload_json;
    v_meta := COALESCE(v_payload->'metadata_json', '{}'::jsonb);
    v_city := COALESCE(v_meta->>'city', v_payload->>'location', 'Unknown');
    v_office_count := COALESCE(v_meta->>'office_count', '?');
    v_signal_type := COALESCE(v_payload->>'signal_type', 'atlas_signal');
    v_confidence := COALESCE((v_payload->>'confidence_score')::NUMERIC, 0.70);
    v_severity_enum := atlas.map_severity_to_enum(COALESCE((v_payload->>'severity_score')::NUMERIC, 0.50));

    UPDATE atlas.lighthouse_bridge_queue
    SET status = 'processing',
        attempt_count = attempt_count + 1,
        processed_at = NOW()
    WHERE queue_id = p_queue_id;

    BEGIN
        -- STEP 1: Create Lighthouse case.
        INSERT INTO public.cases (
            case_number,
            title,
            description,
            case_type,
            jurisdiction,
            domain,
            status,
            priority_level,
            owner_ref,
            created_at,
            updated_at
        ) VALUES (
            'ATLAS-' || v_queue.queue_id::TEXT,
            COALESCE(v_meta->>'title', v_signal_type),
            COALESCE(v_meta->>'description', 'Atlas-generated signal'),
            v_signal_type,
            COALESCE(v_payload->>'geography_key', v_meta->>'geography_key', 'unknown'),
            COALESCE(v_payload->>'source_domain', v_queue.domain_code, 'atlas'),
            'active',
            v_severity_enum,
            'system',
            COALESCE((v_payload->>'detected_at')::TIMESTAMPTZ, NOW()),
            NOW()
        )
        RETURNING id INTO v_case_id;

        -- STEP 2: Create snapshot. Live schema requires snapshot_hash + status.
        INSERT INTO public.snapshots (
            case_id,
            snapshot_hash,
            status,
            created_at
        ) VALUES (
            v_case_id,
            encode(digest(v_case_id::TEXT || ':' || clock_timestamp()::TEXT, 'sha256'), 'hex'),
            'open',
            NOW()
        )
        RETURNING id INTO v_snapshot_id;

        -- STEP 3: Create pipeline run. Live schema uses `status`, not `run_status`.
        INSERT INTO public.pipeline_runs (
            case_id,
            snapshot_id,
            status,
            started_at
        ) VALUES (
            v_case_id,
            v_snapshot_id,
            'running',
            NOW()
        )
        RETURNING id INTO v_pipeline_run_id;

        -- STEP 4: Create claim.
        INSERT INTO public.claims (
            case_id,
            snapshot_id,
            pipeline_run_id,
            claim_text,
            claim_type
        ) VALUES (
            v_case_id,
            v_snapshot_id,
            v_pipeline_run_id,
            'Atlas automated detection: ' || v_signal_type || ' in ' || v_city,
            'systemic'
        )
        RETURNING id INTO v_claim_id;

        -- STEP 5: Create finding.
        INSERT INTO public.findings (
            case_id,
            claim_id,
            snapshot_id,
            pipeline_run_id,
            finding_text,
            confidence_score
        ) VALUES (
            v_case_id,
            v_claim_id,
            v_snapshot_id,
            v_pipeline_run_id,
            COALESCE(
                v_meta->>'finding_text',
                'Atlas detected signal: ' || v_signal_type || ' in ' || v_city ||
                CASE WHEN v_office_count <> '?' THEN ' - ' || v_office_count || ' office/resource count' ELSE '' END
            ),
            v_confidence
        )
        RETURNING id INTO v_finding_id;

        -- STEP 6: Create detected signal.
        INSERT INTO public.detected_signals (
            case_id,
            finding_id,
            snapshot_id,
            pipeline_run_id,
            signal_type,
            signal_description,
            severity,
            confidence_score
        ) VALUES (
            v_case_id,
            v_finding_id,
            v_snapshot_id,
            v_pipeline_run_id,
            v_signal_type,
            COALESCE(v_meta->>'description', 'Atlas-generated signal: ' || v_signal_type || ' in ' || v_city),
            v_severity_enum::public.signal_severity_enum,
            v_confidence
        );

        -- STEP 7: Complete pipeline run. Live schema uses `status`.
        UPDATE public.pipeline_runs
        SET status = 'completed',
            completed_at = NOW()
        WHERE id = v_pipeline_run_id;

        -- STEP 8: Seal snapshot.
        UPDATE public.snapshots
        SET status = 'sealed',
            sealed_at = NOW()
        WHERE id = v_snapshot_id;

        -- STEP 9: Mark bridge queue complete.
        UPDATE atlas.lighthouse_bridge_queue
        SET status = 'completed',
            lighthouse_case_id = v_case_id,
            completed_at = NOW(),
            last_error = NULL
        WHERE queue_id = p_queue_id;

        v_result := jsonb_build_object(
            'success', TRUE,
            'queue_id', p_queue_id,
            'case_id', v_case_id,
            'snapshot_id', v_snapshot_id,
            'pipeline_run_id', v_pipeline_run_id,
            'claim_id', v_claim_id,
            'finding_id', v_finding_id,
            'severity', v_severity_enum
        );

    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
        IF (SELECT attempt_count FROM atlas.lighthouse_bridge_queue WHERE queue_id = p_queue_id) >=
           COALESCE((SELECT max_attempts FROM atlas.lighthouse_bridge_queue WHERE queue_id = p_queue_id), 3)
        THEN
            UPDATE atlas.lighthouse_bridge_queue
            SET status = 'failed',
                last_error = SQLERRM,
                processed_at = NOW()
            WHERE queue_id = p_queue_id;
        ELSE
            UPDATE atlas.lighthouse_bridge_queue
            SET status = 'retrying',
                last_error = SQLERRM,
                next_retry_at = NOW() + INTERVAL '5 minutes',
                processed_at = NOW()
            WHERE queue_id = p_queue_id;
        END IF;

        v_result := jsonb_build_object(
            'success', FALSE,
            'queue_id', p_queue_id,
            'error', SQLERRM
        );
    END;

    RETURN v_result;
END;
$function$

functions.name: bridge_rebuild_map_pins
functions.comment: Rebuilds all civic map pins from current Atlas state. Call after bulk ingestion or nightly via cron.
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION atlas.bridge_rebuild_map_pins()
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'atlas'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_count INT := 0;
BEGIN
    -- Clear expired pins
    DELETE FROM lighthouse_map_pins WHERE expires_at < NOW();

    -- Insert signal pins
    INSERT INTO lighthouse_map_pins (
        geography_key, pin_type, pin_subtype, title, description,
        severity, signal_id, latitude, longitude, color_hex, atlas_updated_at, expires_at
    )
    SELECT
        s.geography_key,
        'signal',
        s.signal_type,
        s.signal_type || ' in ' || COALESCE(g.geography_name, s.geography_key),
        COALESCE(s.metadata_json->>'narrative_summary', s.signal_type),
        s.severity_score,
        s.signal_id,
        lr.latitude,
        lr.longitude,
        CASE
            WHEN s.severity_score >= 0.90 THEN '#7f1d1d'
            WHEN s.severity_score >= 0.75 THEN '#dc2626'
            WHEN s.severity_score >= 0.60 THEN '#f59e0b'
            ELSE '#10b981'
        END,
        s.detected_at,
        s.detected_at + INTERVAL '90 days'
    FROM civic_map_signals s
    LEFT JOIN geography_registry g ON s.geography_key = g.geography_key
    LEFT JOIN location_registry lr ON g.geography_key = lr.geography_key
    WHERE s.active = TRUE
      AND s.detected_at >= CURRENT_DATE - 30
    ON CONFLICT (geography_key, pin_type, entity_id, signal_id) DO UPDATE SET
        severity = EXCLUDED.severity,
        description = EXCLUDED.description,
        atlas_updated_at = EXCLUDED.atlas_updated_at,
        expires_at = EXCLUDED.expires_at;

    GET DIAGNOSTICS v_count = ROW_COUNT;

    -- Insert entity pins (high-risk only)
    INSERT INTO lighthouse_map_pins (
        geography_key, pin_type, pin_subtype, title, description,
        severity, entity_id, latitude, longitude, color_hex, atlas_updated_at, expires_at
    )
    SELECT
        lr.geography_key,
        'entity',
        er.entity_type,
        er.primary_name,
        'Entity active in ' || er.jurisdiction_count || ' jurisdictions',
        COALESCE(le.risk_score, 0.00),
        er.entity_id,
        lr.latitude,
        lr.longitude,
        CASE
            WHEN le.risk_score >= 0.90 THEN '#7f1d1d'
            WHEN le.risk_score >= 0.75 THEN '#dc2626'
            WHEN le.risk_score >= 0.60 THEN '#f59e0b'
            ELSE '#3b82f6'
        END,
        er.updated_at,
        NOW() + INTERVAL '30 days'
    FROM entity_registry er
    JOIN location_registry lr ON er.entity_id = lr.entity_id
    LEFT JOIN lighthouse_entities le ON er.entity_id = le.entity_id
    WHERE le.risk_tier IN ('high', 'critical')
      OR er.jurisdiction_count >= 3
    ON CONFLICT (geography_key, pin_type, entity_id, signal_id) DO UPDATE SET
        severity = EXCLUDED.severity,
        atlas_updated_at = EXCLUDED.atlas_updated_at;

    -- Insert case pins
    INSERT INTO lighthouse_map_pins (
        geography_key, pin_type, pin_subtype, title, description,
        severity, case_id, latitude, longitude, color_hex, atlas_updated_at, expires_at
    )
    SELECT
        lc.geography_key,
        'case',
        lc.case_type,
        lc.case_title,
        lc.case_description,
        lc.severity_score,
        lc.case_id,
        lr.latitude,
        lr.longitude,
        '#8b5cf6',
        lc.atlas_created_at,
        NOW() + INTERVAL '60 days'
    FROM lighthouse_cases lc
    LEFT JOIN location_registry lr ON lc.primary_entity_id = lr.entity_id
    WHERE lc.case_status IN ('open', 'investigating', 'escalated')
    ON CONFLICT (geography_key, pin_type, entity_id, signal_id) DO UPDATE SET
        severity = EXCLUDED.severity,
        atlas_updated_at = EXCLUDED.atlas_updated_at;

    RETURN v_count;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION atlas.bridge_sync_entity_to_lighthouse()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'atlas'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_risk_score DECIMAL(3,2);
    v_risk_tier VARCHAR(16);
BEGIN
    -- Compute risk from signal history
    SELECT COALESCE(MAX(severity_score), 0.00)
    INTO v_risk_score
    FROM civic_map_signals
    WHERE metadata_json->>'entity_id' = NEW.entity_id
;

    v_risk_tier := compute_entity_risk_tier(NEW.entity_id);

    INSERT INTO lighthouse_entities (
        entity_id, entity_type, primary_name, canonical_address,
        canonical_email, canonical_phone, jurisdiction_count,
        source_systems, first_seen_jurisdiction, last_verified,
        is_active, atlas_updated_at, risk_score, risk_tier
    )
    VALUES (
        NEW.entity_id, NEW.entity_type, NEW.primary_name, NEW.canonical_address,
        NEW.canonical_email, NEW.canonical_phone, NEW.jurisdiction_count,
        NEW.source_systems, NEW.first_seen_jurisdiction, NEW.last_verified,
        NEW.is_active, NEW.updated_at, v_risk_score, v_risk_tier
    )
    ON CONFLICT (entity_id) DO UPDATE SET
        primary_name = EXCLUDED.primary_name,
        canonical_address = EXCLUDED.canonical_address,
        canonical_email = EXCLUDED.canonical_email,
        canonical_phone = EXCLUDED.canonical_phone,
        jurisdiction_count = EXCLUDED.jurisdiction_count,
        source_systems = EXCLUDED.source_systems,
        last_verified = EXCLUDED.last_verified,
        is_active = EXCLUDED.is_active,
        atlas_updated_at = EXCLUDED.atlas_updated_at,
        risk_score = EXCLUDED.risk_score,
        risk_tier = EXCLUDED.risk_tier,
        lighthouse_ingested_at = NOW();

    RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

functions.name: bridge_sync_to_lighthouse
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION atlas.bridge_sync_to_lighthouse(p_signal_id bigint DEFAULT NULL::bigint, p_batch_size integer DEFAULT 100)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'atlas'
AS $function$
        DECLARE
            v_bridge RECORD;
            v_signal RECORD;
            v_synced INTEGER := 0;
            v_errors INTEGER := 0;
            v_start_ts TIMESTAMPTZ := clock_timestamp();
            v_case_id UUID;
            v_snapshot_id UUID;
            v_pipeline_run_id UUID;
            v_finding_id UUID;
            v_signal_uuid UUID;
            v_severity TEXT;
        BEGIN
            -- Get bridge config
            SELECT * INTO v_bridge FROM atlas.bridge_config 
            WHERE bridge_id = 'atlas-to-lighthouse' AND enabled = true;
            
            IF v_bridge IS NULL THEN
                RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'Bridge atlas-to-lighthouse not found or disabled');
            END IF;

            -- Iterate over civic_map_signals not yet synced
            FOR v_signal IN 
                SELECT cms.* 
                FROM atlas.civic_map_signals cms
                LEFT JOIN atlas.bridge_sync_log bsl ON (
                    bsl.bridge_id = 'atlas-to-lighthouse' 
                    AND bsl.source_table = 'civic_map_signals' 
                    AND bsl.source_record_id = cms.signal_id::text
                    AND bsl.status = 'sent'
                )
                WHERE (p_signal_id IS NULL OR cms.signal_id = p_signal_id)
                AND bsl.log_id IS NULL
                LIMIT p_batch_size
            LOOP
                BEGIN
                    -- Generate UUIDs for the Lighthouse chain
                    v_case_id := gen_random_uuid();
                    v_snapshot_id := gen_random_uuid();
                    v_pipeline_run_id := gen_random_uuid();
                    v_finding_id := gen_random_uuid();
                    v_signal_uuid := gen_random_uuid();

                    -- Map severity score to Lighthouse enum
                    v_severity := CASE 
                        WHEN v_signal.severity_score >= 8.0 THEN 'critical'
                        WHEN v_signal.severity_score >= 6.0 THEN 'high'
                        WHEN v_signal.severity_score >= 4.0 THEN 'medium'
                        ELSE 'low'
                    END;

                    -- Step 1: Create case in Lighthouse
                    PERFORM net.http_post(
                        url := v_bridge.target_url || '/rest/v1/cases',
                        headers := jsonb_build_object(
                            'apikey', v_bridge.target_service_key,
                            'Authorization', 'Bearer ' || v_bridge.target_service_key,
                            'Content-Type', 'application/json',
                            'Prefer', 'return=representation'
                        ),
                        body := jsonb_build_object(
                            'id', v_case_id,
                            'case_number', 'ATLAS-CMS-' || v_signal.signal_id,
                            'title', 'Civic Signal: ' || v_signal.signal_type || ' in ' || COALESCE(v_signal.geography_key, 'UNKNOWN'),
                            'description', 'Atlas civic map signal detected. Type: ' || v_signal.signal_type || ', Severity: ' || COALESCE(v_signal.severity_score::text, 'N/A') || ', Source: ' || COALESCE(v_signal.source_table, 'N/A'),
                            'case_type', 'atlas_civic_signal',
                            'jurisdiction', COALESCE(v_signal.geography_key, 'US'),
                            'domain', COALESCE((v_signal.metadata_json->>'domain_code')::text, 'CIVIC'),
                            'status', 'open',
                            'priority_level', v_severity,
                            'owner_ref', 'atlas-bridge'
                        )
                    );

                    -- Step 2: Create snapshot
                    PERFORM net.http_post(
                        url := v_bridge.target_url || '/rest/v1/snapshots',
                        headers := jsonb_build_object(
                            'apikey', v_bridge.target_service_key,
                            'Authorization', 'Bearer ' || v_bridge.target_service_key,
                            'Content-Type', 'application/json',
                            'Prefer', 'return=representation'
                        ),
                        body := jsonb_build_object(
                            'id', v_snapshot_id,
                            'case_id', v_case_id,
                            'snapshot_hash', md5(v_signal.signal_id::text || v_signal.signal_type || now()::text),
                            'status', 'sealed'
                        )
                    );

                    -- Step 3: Create pipeline_run
                    PERFORM net.http_post(
                        url := v_bridge.target_url || '/rest/v1/pipeline_runs',
                        headers := jsonb_build_object(
                            'apikey', v_bridge.target_service_key,
                            'Authorization', 'Bearer ' || v_bridge.target_service_key,
                            'Content-Type', 'application/json',
                            'Prefer', 'return=representation'
                        ),
                        body := jsonb_build_object(
                            'id', v_pipeline_run_id,
                            'case_id', v_case_id,
                            'snapshot_id', v_snapshot_id,
                            'status', 'completed',
                            'ruleset_version', 'atlas-bridge-v1'
                        )
                    );

                    -- Step 4: Create finding
                    PERFORM net.http_post(
                        url := v_bridge.target_url || '/rest/v1/findings',
                        headers := jsonb_build_object(
                            'apikey', v_bridge.target_service_key,
                            'Authorization', 'Bearer ' || v_bridge.target_service_key,
                            'Content-Type', 'application/json',
                            'Prefer', 'return=representation'
                        ),
                        body := jsonb_build_object(
                            'id', v_finding_id,
                            'case_id', v_case_id,
                            'claim_id', gen_random_uuid(),
                            'snapshot_id', v_snapshot_id,
                            'pipeline_run_id', v_pipeline_run_id,
                            'finding_text', 'Atlas civic map signal: ' || v_signal.signal_type || ' detected at severity ' || COALESCE(v_signal.severity_score::text, 'N/A') || ' from source ' || COALESCE(v_signal.source_table, 'unknown'),
                            'confidence_score', COALESCE(v_signal.severity_score / 10.0, 0.5)
                        )
                    );

                    -- Step 5: Create detected_signal
                    PERFORM net.http_post(
                        url := v_bridge.target_url || '/rest/v1/detected_signals',
                        headers := jsonb_build_object(
                            'apikey', v_bridge.target_service_key,
                            'Authorization', 'Bearer ' || v_bridge.target_service_key,
                            'Content-Type', 'application/json',
                            'Prefer', 'return=representation'
                        ),
                        body := jsonb_build_object(
                            'id', v_signal_uuid,
                            'case_id', v_case_id,
                            'finding_id', v_finding_id,
                            'snapshot_id', v_snapshot_id,
                            'pipeline_run_id', v_pipeline_run_id,
                            'signal_type', v_signal.signal_type,
                            'signal_description', 'Atlas civic map signal from ' || COALESCE(v_signal.source_table, 'unknown') || '. Geography: ' || COALESCE(v_signal.geography_key, 'N/A') || '. Source record: ' || COALESCE(v_signal.source_record_id, 'N/A'),
                            'severity', v_severity,
                            'confidence_score', COALESCE(v_signal.severity_score / 10.0, 0.5)
                        )
                    );

                    -- Log success
                    INSERT INTO atlas.bridge_sync_log (bridge_id, sync_type, source_table, source_record_id, target_table, target_record_id, status, request_payload)
                    VALUES ('atlas-to-lighthouse', 'sync_civic_signal', 'civic_map_signals', v_signal.signal_id::text, 'detected_signals', v_signal_uuid::text, 'sent',
                        jsonb_build_object(
                            'signal_type', v_signal.signal_type,
                            'geography_key', v_signal.geography_key,
                            'severity', v_severity,
                            'case_id', v_case_id,
                            'finding_id', v_finding_id
                        ));

                    v_synced := v_synced + 1;
                EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
                    INSERT INTO atlas.bridge_sync_log (bridge_id, sync_type, source_table, source_record_id, status, error_message)
                    VALUES ('atlas-to-lighthouse', 'sync_civic_signal', 'civic_map_signals', v_signal.signal_id::text, 'error', SQLERRM);
                    v_errors := v_errors + 1;
                END;
            END LOOP;

            -- Update bridge status
            UPDATE atlas.bridge_config SET 
                last_sync_at = now(), 
                last_sync_status = CASE WHEN v_errors = 0 THEN 'success' ELSE 'partial' END,
                last_sync_error = CASE WHEN v_errors > 0 THEN v_errors || ' errors during sync' ELSE NULL END,
                updated_at = now()
            WHERE bridge_id = 'atlas-to-lighthouse';

            RETURN jsonb_build_object(
                'success', true,
                'synced', v_synced,
                'errors', v_errors,
                'duration_ms', EXTRACT(MILLISECONDS FROM clock_timestamp() - v_start_ts)::integer
            );
        END;
        $function$

functions.name: bridge_sync_to_rosetta
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION atlas.bridge_sync_to_rosetta(p_provider_id character varying DEFAULT NULL::character varying, p_batch_size integer DEFAULT 50)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'atlas'
AS $function$
        DECLARE
            v_bridge RECORD;
            v_provider RECORD;
            v_synced INTEGER := 0;
            v_errors INTEGER := 0;
            v_start_ts TIMESTAMPTZ := clock_timestamp();
            v_program_id TEXT;
        BEGIN
            -- Get bridge config
            SELECT * INTO v_bridge FROM atlas.bridge_config 
            WHERE bridge_id = 'atlas-to-rosetta' AND enabled = true;
            
            IF v_bridge IS NULL THEN
                RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'Bridge atlas-to-rosetta not found or disabled');
            END IF;

            -- Iterate over legal aid providers that haven't been synced yet
            FOR v_provider IN 
                SELECT lap.* 
                FROM atlas.legal_aid_providers lap
                LEFT JOIN atlas.bridge_sync_log bsl ON (
                    bsl.bridge_id = 'atlas-to-rosetta' 
                    AND bsl.source_table = 'legal_aid_providers' 
                    AND bsl.source_record_id = lap.provider_id
                    AND bsl.status = 'sent'
                )
                WHERE (p_provider_id IS NULL OR lap.provider_id = p_provider_id)
                AND bsl.log_id IS NULL
                LIMIT p_batch_size
            LOOP
                BEGIN
                    -- Generate a deterministic program ID
                    v_program_id := 'atlas-' || v_provider.provider_id;

                    -- Push help_program to Rosetta
                    PERFORM net.http_post(
                        url := v_bridge.target_url || '/rest/v1/help_program',
                        headers := jsonb_build_object(
                            'apikey', v_bridge.target_service_key,
                            'Authorization', 'Bearer ' || v_bridge.target_service_key,
                            'Content-Type', 'application/json',
                            'Prefer', 'resolution=merge-duplicates'
                        ),
                        body := jsonb_build_object(
                            'id', v_program_id,
                            'corpus_id', 1,
                            'source_document_id', 1,
                            'extraction_run_id', 1,
                            'canon_version', 1,
                            'program_name', v_provider.provider_name || COALESCE(' - ' || v_provider.program_name, ''),
                            'program_type', COALESCE(v_provider.service_type, 'legal_aid'),
                            'governing_section', 'Atlas Entity Extraction',
                            'status', 'active',
                            'signal_status', 'synced_from_atlas'
                        )
                    );

                    -- Push help_program_contacts to Rosetta
                    IF v_provider.phone IS NOT NULL OR v_provider.email IS NOT NULL THEN
                        PERFORM net.http_post(
                            url := v_bridge.target_url || '/rest/v1/help_program_contacts',
                            headers := jsonb_build_object(
                                'apikey', v_bridge.target_service_key,
                                'Authorization', 'Bearer ' || v_bridge.target_service_key,
                                'Content-Type', 'application/json',
                                'Prefer', 'resolution=merge-duplicates'
                            ),
                            body := jsonb_build_object(
                                'id', v_program_id || '-contact',
                                'help_program_id', v_program_id,
                                'contact_type', CASE WHEN v_provider.phone IS NOT NULL THEN 'phone' ELSE 'email' END,
                                'entity_name', v_provider.provider_name,
                                'governing_section', 'Atlas Entity Extraction'
                            )
                        );
                    END IF;

                    -- Push help_program_locations to Rosetta
                    IF v_provider.jurisdiction IS NOT NULL THEN
                        PERFORM net.http_post(
                            url := v_bridge.target_url || '/rest/v1/help_program_locations',
                            headers := jsonb_build_object(
                                'apikey', v_bridge.target_service_key,
                                'Authorization', 'Bearer ' || v_bridge.target_service_key,
                                'Content-Type', 'application/json',
                                'Prefer', 'resolution=merge-duplicates'
                            ),
                            body := jsonb_build_object(
                                'id', v_program_id || '-loc',
                                'help_program_id', v_program_id,
                                'jurisdiction_level', 'state',
                                'jurisdiction_name', v_provider.jurisdiction,
                                'applicability_note', 'Synced from Atlas legal_aid_providers. City: ' || COALESCE(v_provider.city, 'N/A')
                            )
                        );
                    END IF;

                    -- Log success
                    INSERT INTO atlas.bridge_sync_log (bridge_id, sync_type, source_table, source_record_id, target_table, target_record_id, status, request_payload)
                    VALUES ('atlas-to-rosetta', 'sync_help_program', 'legal_aid_providers', v_provider.provider_id, 'help_program', v_program_id, 'sent',
                        jsonb_build_object('provider_name', v_provider.provider_name, 'jurisdiction', v_provider.jurisdiction));

                    v_synced := v_synced + 1;
                EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
                    INSERT INTO atlas.bridge_sync_log (bridge_id, sync_type, source_table, source_record_id, status, error_message)
                    VALUES ('atlas-to-rosetta', 'sync_help_program', 'legal_aid_providers', v_provider.provider_id, 'error', SQLERRM);
                    v_errors := v_errors + 1;
                END;
            END LOOP;

            -- Also sync contacts from v_rosetta_contacts view
            -- This handles entities that are nonprofits/orgs/agencies with contacts
            FOR v_provider IN
                SELECT vrc.*
                FROM atlas.v_rosetta_contacts vrc
                LEFT JOIN atlas.bridge_sync_log bsl ON (
                    bsl.bridge_id = 'atlas-to-rosetta'
                    AND bsl.source_table = 'v_rosetta_contacts'
                    AND bsl.source_record_id = vrc.contact_id::text
                    AND bsl.status = 'sent'
                )
                WHERE bsl.log_id IS NULL
                LIMIT p_batch_size
            LOOP
                BEGIN
                    v_program_id := 'atlas-entity-' || v_provider.entity_id;

                    -- Push as help_program_contacts
                    PERFORM net.http_post(
                        url := v_bridge.target_url || '/rest/v1/help_program_contacts',
                        headers := jsonb_build_object(
                            'apikey', v_bridge.target_service_key,
                            'Authorization', 'Bearer ' || v_bridge.target_service_key,
                            'Content-Type', 'application/json',
                            'Prefer', 'resolution=merge-duplicates'
                        ),
                        body := jsonb_build_object(
                            'id', 'atlas-contact-' || v_provider.contact_id,
                            'help_program_id', v_program_id,
                            'contact_type', v_provider.contact_type,
                            'entity_name', v_provider.entity_name,
                            'governing_section', 'Atlas Entity Extraction - ' || v_provider.source_schema_name
                        )
                    );

                    INSERT INTO atlas.bridge_sync_log (bridge_id, sync_type, source_table, source_record_id, target_table, target_record_id, status)
                    VALUES ('atlas-to-rosetta', 'sync_contact', 'v_rosetta_contacts', v_provider.contact_id::text, 'help_program_contacts', 'atlas-contact-' || v_provider.contact_id, 'sent');

                    v_synced := v_synced + 1;
                EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
                    INSERT INTO atlas.bridge_sync_log (bridge_id, sync_type, source_table, source_record_id, status, error_message)
                    VALUES ('atlas-to-rosetta', 'sync_contact', 'v_rosetta_contacts', v_provider.contact_id::text, 'error', SQLERRM);
                    v_errors := v_errors + 1;
                END;
            END LOOP;

            -- Update bridge status
            UPDATE atlas.bridge_config SET 
                last_sync_at = now(), 
                last_sync_status = CASE WHEN v_errors = 0 THEN 'success' ELSE 'partial' END,
                last_sync_error = CASE WHEN v_errors > 0 THEN v_errors || ' errors during sync' ELSE NULL END,
                updated_at = now()
            WHERE bridge_id = 'atlas-to-rosetta';

            RETURN jsonb_build_object(
                'success', true,
                'synced', v_synced,
                'errors', v_errors,
                'duration_ms', EXTRACT(MILLISECONDS FROM clock_timestamp() - v_start_ts)::integer
            );
        END;
        $function$
